Message:
Fia’s emotions flowed
into the flower,
and then into me.

Her wish for us to
save Yubera together
was painfully clear.

...Yes, that’s right...
Even if I can’t
save her by myself,
the two of us together
can surely—

This flower was originally
meant to suppress Fia’s power.

But, if we wish it to,
the flower should be able to
suppress Yubera’s power, too.

In exchange, I’ll disappear.
But, that’s fine.
That’s how it should be...

This time, I’m no longer
stuck just watching—
I have the power
to save someone.

As the “Witch of Murder,”
it’s an end far happier
than I deserve.

Our power then
poured into Yubera,
as if our very lives were
overflowing from the flower.

Its petals lost all color,
and my consciousness
began to fade.

Ahh... With this,
I can finally
lay everything to rest...
Thank you, Fia.

I wish that you may also be
blessed with a happy death—

Countless specks of light filled my vision,
my consciousness melting
to become one with them.

My guilt and regret began to fade away.
I was in bliss, ascending to Heaven, when...
I suddenly heard a voice ring out...

“If you’re gonna die anyway,
why not give your life over to me?”

Heh... Good grief...
Nothing ever goes
the way I want, huh...?

But, that’s alright.
Dying for your sake...
doesn’t sound so bad, either—
